minimal.title: Problem
minimal.prompt: In one or two sentences, what's the problem this product solves, and who has it acutely?
minimal.framing: Pin down the pain. Name the people who feel it most often, not just the abstract market.
minimal.response_format_hint: Answer as one or two sentences under the heading. No bullets needed.

minimal.title: Jobs to be Done
minimal.prompt: What jobs is the user trying to get done when they hit this problem? List the two or three most load-bearing.
minimal.framing: Focus on the verbs the user is trying to execute, not the features they imagine you'll build.
minimal.response_format_hint: Answer as a short bulleted list (2-3 bullets) under the heading.

minimal.title: Value Chain
minimal.prompt: Who's already in the value chain for this need — vendors, intermediaries, end users — and where do you sit?
minimal.framing: Place the product on the map of who-pays-whom-for-what. Be honest about where the dollars currently flow.
minimal.response_format_hint: Answer as one paragraph under the heading.

minimal.title: Competitive Landscape
minimal.prompt: Closest two or three alternatives users currently reach for, and the one thing each gets wrong for your user.
minimal.framing: Name the actual incumbents (or workarounds — spreadsheets count) and the one durable flaw each carries.
minimal.response_format_hint: Answer as a short bulleted list (2-3 bullets) under the heading; each bullet names a competitor and the one thing it gets wrong.

minimal.title: Wedge
minimal.prompt: What's the smallest, sharpest entry point into this market — the wedge a single team could execute?
minimal.framing: Describe the narrow first cut, not the eventual product. A wedge is testable in weeks, not quarters.
minimal.response_format_hint: Answer as one paragraph under the heading.

minimal.title: Vision
minimal.prompt: If the wedge works, what does the full product look like in three years?
minimal.framing: Three-year horizon. What does the product become if the wedge lands and the team gets to keep building?
minimal.response_format_hint: Answer as one paragraph under the heading.

minimal.title: Wedge to Full Vision
minimal.prompt: What's the bridge from wedge to full vision — the two or three steps in between?
minimal.framing: The intermediate beats. Each one should be a coherent shippable product on its own.
minimal.response_format_hint: Answer as a short bulleted list (2-3 bullets) under the heading; each bullet is one intermediate step.

minimal.title: MVP
minimal.prompt: What's the leanest thing you could ship in 8 weeks to validate the wedge?
minimal.framing: Eight-week scope, not eight-month. Name what's in and (more importantly) what's deliberately out.
minimal.response_format_hint: Answer as one paragraph under the heading; mention what's in scope AND what's explicitly out.

extended_additions.title: Bear Case
extended_additions.prompt: What's the strongest reason this doesn't work — the bear case a skeptic would lead with?
extended_additions.framing: Steel-man the doubters. The most credible reason this product fails, written without defensiveness.
extended_additions.response_format_hint: Answer as one paragraph under the heading.

extended_additions.title: Bull Case
extended_additions.prompt: What's the most optimistic outcome that's still plausible — the bull case in three lines?
extended_additions.framing: Stretch but not fantasy. The best-realistic-case scenario in three lines.
extended_additions.response_format_hint: Answer as a short bulleted list (3 bullets) under the heading.

extended_additions.title: Quick Notes
extended_additions.prompt: Any quick notes, links, or one-liners worth preserving in the brief?
extended_additions.framing: Loose ends, link dumps, half-formed observations. The brief's catch-all.
extended_additions.response_format_hint: Answer as bullets under the heading. Links and one-liners are welcome.

extended_additions.title: References
extended_additions.prompt: List references — links, related products, prior art, or background reading the reader should pull on.
extended_additions.framing: Pointers a future reader of the brief would want. Prior art, related products, background reading.
extended_additions.response_format_hint: Answer as a bulleted list of links or names under the heading.
